faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is conducting this recruitment drive for the Consultant – ED Secretariat position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant – ED Secretariat post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Consultant – ED Secretariat position is 20-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Consultant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS with MD (Community Medicine/PSM) and 1 year post-qualification experience, or an MBBS/BDS with MPH and 2 years post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NHSRC Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years, with age relaxation of up to 5 years applicable for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Consultant – ED Secretariat post will receive a monthly salary ranging between Rs. 60,000 and Rs. 1,20,000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Nil, meaning there is no fee required to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test (if applicable, minimum 70% required) followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the NHSRC Consultant – ED Secretariat post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official NHSRC website by filling out the application form and uploading necessary documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official notification and website?
faq.answer: You can check the official notification and website by visiting the designated important links section provided in this article for direct access.
